inspection_checklist: Visit the named collectors: confirm premises, vehicles and storage; check their registration dates and sales to other buyers.
Physically verify a sample of purchase invoices with the sellers (weighbridge slips, e-way bills, vehicle logs).
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
